hey, im a parent of a 7yo and im kinda struggling with how to handle stuff they hear at school about gender identity and pronouns. like, how can i explain these concepts to my kid in a way that is age-appropriate and actually correct? i want to make sure i'm doing it the right way.

Start by focusing on the idea that people have different names for themselves, similar to how some people choose the pronouns "he/she" and others might prefer "they." You can explain that a child might tell you their name doesn't match their gender label, so using the pronouns those they select is simply about making them feel comfortable and safe. Approach this conversation with an open, non-judgmental heart, acknowledging that it can feel confusing but emphasizing that respecting people as they are helps them
